case.pattern_description: Coordinated multi-card abuse executed through device D004630 operating behind an anonymous proxy. The device was observed attempting online purchases across six distinct card accounts within a three-day window, appearing as a new device on each account. This coordinated syndicated abuse matches earlier confirmed fraud cases on the same device that were categorized as undocumented fraud under Policy R9.

evidence.claim: Flagged transaction 3466014 received a low model score of 0.014 (historical fraud rate 0.006) and a legacy risk score of 0.12, which did not trigger the standard queue alert.
Transaction 3466014 was executed using device D004630, which is new to card C02975-K1 and operated behind an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS).

Device D004630 belongs to ring 57672119 and was used across six distinct cards (C01996-K2, C10326-K1, C02975-K1, C13487-K1, C09975-K1, C08168-K1) between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-17, appearing as a new device behind an anonymous proxy on every account.

Device D004630 is linked to four prior confirmed fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035) where cardholders reported unauthorized purchases from this specific Samsung SM-G935F profile behind an anonymous proxy.

The specific holder identity on card C02975-K1 has zero prior transactions in confirmed fraud cases and no prior history on file, representing a first-time online transaction without an established recurring baseline.

evidence.claim: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns: Rule R9: Undocumented patterns. When activity fits none of the known patterns but the evidence shows coordinated or repeated abuse across customers, recommend `CREATE_CASE`, `FILE_REPORT`, and `ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST`, and describe the pattern in your own words. Do not force it into a known category.

Rule R6: Shared origin: Rule R6: Shared origin. When several cards show fraud from the same device profile, the same billing region, or the same recipient email in one window, name the shared element, recommend `CREATE_CASE` and `FILE_REPORT`, and `MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS` for every card that shares it.

case.summary: Transaction 3466014 ($36.12) on card C02975-K1 was flagged via monitoring due to association with device ring 57672119. Although the transaction received a low model score of 0.014, device D004630 operated behind an anonymous proxy and appeared as new to this cardholder account. Cross-card graph analysis showed that this specific device was used across six distinct cards between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-17 and is tied to four confirmed fraud closed cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, CC-3035). Given the coordinated multi-card abuse, the alert was assessed as uncertain at a 0.29 fraud probability under the undocumented pattern (Policy R9). The case has been opened, connected cards are set to monitored status, and the file is escalated to an analyst.
